study type: Observational study (post-hoc analysis of prospective data)
cohort: The study included 79 preterm and 207 term neonates who underwent cerebral near-infrared spectroscopy (NIRS) monitoring and oscillometric blood pressure measurement at 15 minutes after birth.
finding: In compromised preterm neonates with lower gestational age and in need of respiratory support, cardiac output (CO) was associated with cerebral-regional-oxygen-saturation (crSO2) and cerebral-fractional-tissue-oxygen-extraction (cFTOE), but no associations were observed in stable preterm neonates with higher gestational age or in term neonates.
gest_age: Preterm neonates (mean GA 29.4 ± 3.7 weeks and 34.9 ± 1.3 weeks) and term neonates.
